objectives.title: Generate an OpenAPI spec from your codebase
objectives.why: A spec makes your API documented, mockable, and testable — the foundation for everything else.

objectives.title: Create a mock server for frontend development
objectives.why: Mocks let the frontend build against realistic responses before the API is done.

objectives.title: Run your collection as tests
objectives.why: Running the collection turns your requests into a repeatable test suite.

objectives.title: Security-audit your API (OWASP API Top 10)
objectives.why: Catch the common API vulnerabilities before they ship.

bestPractices.title: Keep your Postman API key out of git
bestPractices.why: Secrets in git are secrets leaked.

bestPractices.title: Describe your endpoints well enough for AI agents
bestPractices.why: Clear summaries and named params are what let AI agents actually use your API.

criteria.rubric: Do the operations have clear summaries/descriptions and named, described parameters suitable for an AI agent to call?

badges.name: Great Pretender
badges.description: Stood up your first mock server.

badges.name: Locked Down
badges.description: Ran a security audit on your API.

badges.name: Agent-Ready
badges.description: Your API is described well enough for agents to use.
